events.text: [Inchunwa and the revivalization of Southeastern tattoos featured in an article published in The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/may/04/native-women-facial-tattoos).
[“Icho’wa: Capturing the Resurgence of Ancestral Marking” published in Chokma Magazine](https://www.instagram.com/p/DKxKNStMGCw/?img_index=1).
Research trip to Three Mound Site: Poverty Point, Nanih Waiya (and the archives of MBCI Immi Archives), Moundville + Lake Tibbi.
Inchunwa began working more closely with tattoo practitioners to support their work in ancestral marking.
Patreon Book Club begins with the book Drawing With Great Needles.
Indigi Pop X: Inchunwa had a panel and booth at IPX in North Carolina.
